name: dev-kit
description: PeoplesHR developer build tooling. Ships the hrm-deployment-script skill for reformatting SQL to PHR conventions in .NET Framework projects, the hrm-notification skill for building a Job Scheduler email notification for any module, the phx-debugger skill for fixing an Azure DevOps bug end to end from its bug ID, the hrm-configuration-document skill for writing the house Configuration Document (.md, .docx, PDF) for a finished CR, and the phx-product-context skill for grounding answers about PeoplesHR module behaviour in the product documentation held in WeKnora. Declares the weknora MCP server for read-only retrieval from the PeoplesHR knowledge bases. phx-product-context moved here from org-standards in 2.0.0.
